create_unFlowLoss: create an unFlowLoss module to compute photometric and smoothness losses for optical flow estimation
compute_photometric_loss: compute photometric loss between scaled and reconstructed images using L1, SSIM, and ternary terms with visibility masking
compute_smoothness_loss: compute edge-aware smoothness loss for optical flow using first or second order gradient regularization
compute_homography_smoothness: compute homography-based smoothness loss for flow using full segmentation and occlusion masks with RANSAC threshold
compute_pyramid_flow_loss: compute multi-scale photometric and smoothness losses for forward-backward optical flow pyramid with occlusion-aware visibility masks
